apibalego.config.web.webDataSync.name: Enable HTTP syncing
apibalego.config.web.webDataSync.comment: CAREFUL: enables gamemaster-mode, allowing the player you decide to connect to to control the mod's features and more. Requires reloading the world.
apibalego.config.web.dataSyncUrl.name: Data sync URL
apibalego.config.web.dataSyncApiKey.name: Data sync API key
How much time (in minutes) must pass between each server query. Must be at least 10 seconds.
apibalego.config.web.liveUpdateService.c: CAREFUL: creates a websocket connection with the gamemaster, allowing them to control the mod in real time. Requires reloading the world.
apibalego.config.web.liveUpdateUrl.name: Live update URL
apibalego.config.web.liveUpdatePort.name: Live update port
apibalego.config.web.remoteCommandExecut: Allow the gamemaster to execute any arbitrary command.
Allow the gamemaster to download and enable/disable datapacks. Note that newly loaded content may not be sent to already-connected players until they rejoin.
apibalego.config.web.remoteDatapackAllow: If disabled, datapack download URLs must be on the same origin as the data sync URL. Enable to allow downloading from any URL.
apibalego.config.web.clientDataSync.name: Enable client HTTP syncing
apibalego.config.web.clientDataSync.comm: CAREFUL: allows the client to connect to a gamemaster on its own, independent of any joined server (e.g. from the main menu).
apibalego.config.web.clientDataSyncReloa: How much time (in minutes) must pass between each client query. Must be at least 10 seconds.
apibalego.commands.gmaster.help:
Allows to configure the server to connect to a gamemaster console and enable §5gamemaster mode§r.
§eMake sure to only connect to trusted sources, as they will be able to remotely run commands and more!§r
apibalego.commands.gmaster.status_on_ok: Gamemaster mode is enabled. Connected to URL '%s', last update was successful.
apibalego.commands.gmaster.status_on_ko: Gamemaster mode is enabled. Connected to URL '%s', §4last update was not successful.§r
apibalego.commands.gmaster.status_time: Last successful update: %s. Last update attempt: %s.
apibalego.commands.gmaster.disabled: Cannot run gamemaster command, as gamemaster mode is disabled.
apibalego.commands.gmaster.set_on: Enabled gamemaster mode! Make sure to only connect to trusted sources. Current gamemaster URL is: '%s'
apibalego.commands.gmaster.already_on: Gamemaster mode is already enabled. Current gamemaster URL is: '%s'
apibalego.commands.gmaster.url_set: Set gamemaster URL to '%s'. Make sure to only connect to trusted sources!
apibalego.commands.gmaster.url_not_valid: The specified URL is not valid: '%s'. Make sure to put it in quotes and with the prefix (example: 'http://localhost:5000').
